name: Xiaoman: Habit & Journal
subtitle: Small habits, little by little
promotionalText: A little every day, and life slowly fills up. A simple, gentle habit tracker and journal.
whatsNew: Xiaoman now speaks English and Traditional Chinese. Change the language anytime in Settings.
description:
Xiaoman is a simple, gentle habit tracker and journal. Light up a few small habits each day, write a few lines, and watch your days slowly fill up.

CHECK IN WITH A TAP
· Tap a circle to check in, with a little animation, sound and haptic
· Tap a checked circle to note how it felt
· Swipe between days to check in late if you forgot
· Pick an icon, color, shape and repeat days for each habit

REMINDERS THAT RING
· Set several reminder times for each habit
· It rings on time and reminds you again if you haven’t checked in; once you have, it stays quiet

NOTES AND MOODS
· Write quick notes and record your mood each day
· Browse past days in Memories

STATS AND REVIEWS
· See completion and check-ins by week, month and year
· Get a weekly summary of your check-ins

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
· Check in right from your Home Screen; finished habits disappear
· The note widget opens today’s note in one tap and never shows your notes on the Home Screen

MAKE IT YOURS
· Themes, fonts, icon shapes and color palettes
· Use your own photos as habit icons (Premium)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
· No sign-up; your data stays on your phone
· Passcode lock and Face ID (Premium)
· Export a backup anytime

About Premium:
· Yearly (with a 3-day free trial for first-time subscribers) and Monthly are auto-renewing subscriptions, renewed within 24 hours before the current period ends. Cancel anytime in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. Lifetime is a one-time purchase.
